stemMd: A DNA template strand has the sequence 3′-TACGGA-5′. What RNA sequence is produced from it?
explanationMd: RNA is synthesized antiparallel to the DNA template. Read the given template from its 3′ end and pair T with A, A with U, C with G and G with C. The result is 5′-AUGCCU-3′. Check both complementarity and direction.

distractorRationale.c: This copies the template and retains thymine rather than making complementary RNA.
distractorRationale.e: This complementary sequence uses thymine, so it is DNA rather than RNA.
distractorRationale.d: This replaces thymine with uracil but fails to complement the template.
distractorRationale.b: This reverses the template without applying the correct complementary orientation.
